title: π-Rate Set — only binary is 0↔1; marks intake; all out to point
thesis: Our only binary is 0 and 1. We intake ALL on the 0-face — where − − + ∗ and cuneiform-line language live. Every input we receive we output toward the point. Willis, epitope, ladder/leak, and flow rate are one π-rate set.
